WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_length, avg_ratio FROM per_rating
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_rating;
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
         AVG(length) AS avg_length,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_rental_rate, avg_length, avg_replacement_cost
FROM per_rating
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Average', AVG(avg_rental_rate), AVG(avg_length), AVG(avg_replacement_cost)
FROM per_rating;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_length, ratio FROM r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'AVERAGE', AVG(avg_length), AVG(ratio) FROM r
SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
GROUP BY rating
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, AVG(ratio) FROM (
  SELECT AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
);
SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost
FROM (
  SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, 0 AS sort_order
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ALL' AS rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, 1 AS sort_order
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
)
ORDER BY sort_order, rating;
SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_rental_rate, avg_length, avg_replacement_cost
FROM (
  SELECT rating AS rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration,
         AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
         AVG(length) AS avg_length,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         0 AS sort_key
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ALL' AS rating,
         AVG(rental_duration),
         AVG(rental_rate),
         AVG(length),
         AVG(replacement_cost),
         1 AS sort_key
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
)
ORDER BY sort_key, rating;
